from: The credit that appears carries the invoice's number, which is what makes it the right kind for this case.
to: The credit that appears carries the invoice's number. You also need the other kind, for comparison: click "Customers" in the top menu, open a customer, click the "Invoices" tab, click "Issue Credit", type an amount in "Amount", choose "Issue Store Credit" under "Outcome", type a short note in "Reason", and click "Issue Credit" - that one carries no invoice number. Print and read both.
